notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.2.4 - Snow Lake Update!
notes.notes:
Welcome Canyoneers!

I'm happy to announce a new FREE update for Polyville Canyon! Perfect timing to celebrate the one-year anniversary of the initial Polyville Canyon release!

Version 1.2.4 is now live and ready for you all! This update contains a TON of new stuff! See below for details!


 All new map called Snow Lake - Build a wonderous new town in the colder regions of Polyville!
 Over a dozen new items including a Visitor Center, The Whale Shack, and more!
 Five new Neighbors to meet and greet out and around town! This comes with even more Neighbor-based benefits like cheaper residences, or more train passengers when they are unlocked!
 New Level Cap - Previously you capped at level 16. This update increases the level cap to level 19!
 Three new unmissable Achievements for end game
 New objectives in Story Mode
 Two all-new custom music tracks created by Tomás Palazzi!
 New ability to skip the current music track using the TAB key
 Other minor bug fixes, updates and some UI adjustments


Snow Lake is a beautiful landscape of ice and snow blanketing the entire region with a large lake in the northeast end, and a smaller lake to the northwest. As usual, only bridges may be built across the water, but long stretches of bridges will get you to the other side!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38041447/21b59fc0fcaaf6d9b9e182deb80c0c2db572335e.png

Also included are over a dozen new items to build from new residences like the "Snow Lake Cabin", to new commercial buildings like "The Whale Shack" and more!

For existing players that have already completed the game and finished all objectives, the story mode will pick up where you left off!

Also of note, this release is coming on the 1-year anniversary of the Polyville Canyon official release! Thank you to all who have played my game and continue to play a year later! If you're new, welcome to Polyville and I hope you have a great time!

Tim @ Henagames

notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.1.2 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog Version 1.1.2

- Introduced the new "Mini Item Catalog" - When placing new items from the Item Catalog, a smaller version of it will now show on screen while building that lets you swap for new items without opening the Catalog again. This is extremely helpful when placing roads!

- Updated the Neighbor Request UI to provide more feedback when you are in between Request sets. There are only so many Neighbor Requests per level. Previously, the Request button would disappear entirely, but now the button will just fade back with a more informational tooltip letting you know to level up for new requests

- Fixed an issue with UI closing/opening in the wrong order when leveling up and completing a Neighbor Request at the same time

- Added an item "Size" to the item info screen. Now all items have a size based on the grid, so a "1 x 1" item like the Cozy Starter home, or the Pine Tree would fill in one grid unit completely. A "2 x 3" would fill 6 grid units, and so on. Some items, like most Objects, are smaller than a grid unit, so you will see sizes like "0.25 x 0.5" instead of whole numbers.

- Fixed an issue with the game not saving Quality setting preferences properly

- Fixed an issue with resetting perks calculations

- Fixed a few objects collisions to prevent them from being built in the middle of the ocean on the Island map.

- Updated the First Person view to NOT require holding the right-mouse-button to look around. Also removed the "Fly Back to Station" and "Exit" buttons. This is all controlled via the keyboard now and helper text is now displayed where the buttons used to be.

notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.1.0 Release Notes - Sandbox Mode Update
notes.notes:
Sandbox Mode
I am happy to announce that Polyville Canyon Sandbox Mode is now available!

In Sandbox Mode you have free reign to build whatever you want in any location from the very beginning!

Want to skip all the Neighbor Requests, Goals, Leveling Up and unlocking things? Sandbox Mode is fully playable without having to play through Story Mode first!

- Start at Max Level -
- All Items are Unlocked -
- All Items are FREE to build -
- All Locations are Unlocked -
- No Polyville Perks to Earn -
- No Goals or Neighbor Requests to fulfill -

The Neighbors can't wait to see what you have planned! Get started in Sandbox Mode today!

Existing Players - A note on the Main Menu
If you're an existing player updating to v1.1.0, the Main Menu has changed slightly. To continue your previously saved game, select the "STORY" button on the Main Menu, then select "CONTINUE". This will load and continue your in-progress game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38041447/e88e493d421c9426707d06024efc70497f5a970b.png

Story Mode and Sandbox Mode are separate save files. You can have both a Story and a Sandbox save at the same time.

Additional Release notes for v1.1.0

- Updated the Main Menu to reflect addition of Sandbox mode

- Added ability to switch between locations while in-game

- Added additional error handling around Train Departures

- Other small tweaks, updates and fixes

notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.0.4.1 - Hotfix Update
notes.notes:
Changelog Version 1.0.4.1

- Fixed an issue with the game becoming unresponsive when clicking into Neighbor View with the "eye" icon

- Fixed an issue with game getting trapped in a UI loop when pressing ESCAPE from within the Settings menu in-game

- Fixed an issue with pressing escape while in Neighbor View and becoming stuck in the UI

notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.0.4 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Changelog Version 1.0.4

- Fixed an issue with the UI becoming unresponsive if you paused the game with the SPACE BAR, then used ESC to access the in-game menu. The UI would become unresponsive until you paused and unpaused the game again with the SPACE BAR

- Refactored some other code regarding pausing of the game

- Removed horizontal axis from first-person inverted cam. Inverted cam now affects vertical axis only

- Added error handling and instructions for dealing with corrupted save files. Corrupted save files are not common in Polyville Canyon. If you are experiencing issues getting stuck on the loading screen, there is a chance your save file has been corrupted. The game will recognize this and automatically create a new save file upon relaunch.

- Refactored some code to help prevent any issue related to "Can't select any item". This error seems to have been caused by certain flags not being reset properly. The code has been centralized and optimized to help prevent ending up in this state

- Fixed an issue with the Train Clock not resetting to default time when returning from the game to the Main Menu and selecting "New Game"

- Fixed an issue where the game would become unresponsive if you started a new game multiple times in one session

- Update the Neighbor Request "The Great Outdoors" to include instructions to visit Polyville River in order to add those items to the catalog

- Additional code tweaks to help prevent Neighbor Requests from getting stuck in completed state, but not advancing

notes.title: Polyville Canyon Changelog for v1.0.3
notes.notes:
This update is centered mostly around game feedback to Henagames to help identify and fix some of the remaining issues that players are running into, along with a couple of other quality-of-life updates.

Thank you for your patience as I track these issues down and find permanent fixes for them. I appreciate everyone's understanding and willingness to help a small developer out by reporting the issues. 

--------------------------

Changelog Version 1.0.3

- Added "Invert Mouse in First Person Mode" setting in Settings > General

- Added "First-Person Rotation Sensitivity" setting in Settings > General

- Added ability to toggle on/off "World Flattening" in Settings > General. Turning this off will keep all items at full size while in placement/build mode

- Added a "SEND ISSUE REPORT" button on the Main Menu. This will send the log files to Henagames in the background. If you have run into an issue with the game, relaunch and send the bug report before proceeding.

notes.title: Polyville Canyon v1.0.2 - Release Notes
notes.notes:
The following are a list of changes found in Polyville Canyon v1.0.2.

- Added ability to Skip the Tutorial

----- If skipped, you will not earn the "Complete the Tutorial" Achievement

----- If skipped, Neighbor Requests begin when you reach Level 2

- Added a new Snap Level "Micro-Snap", accessed by using the "4" key while holding any item except for Roads. PATHS are eligible for Micro-Snap*

- Added ability for all paths to be built on top of each other and can be finely placed using Micro-Snap

- Added an optional checkbox to prevent the GOALS panel from popping up every time a Goal is complete. If you choose to disable the auto-popup, you will instead see a numbered-alert of how many Goals have been completed since the last time you checked it. This will clear once you open the Goals panel manually by clicking on the checkered-flag icon

- Added a small delay to the "Let's Go" and "Skip Tutorial" buttons in the Neighbor Request view to prevent quick-clicking through it

- Adjusted the requirement for the Achievement "Mega Income" from $50,000 in Ticket Prices to $25,000 in Ticket Prices for balancing

- Adjusted the "Tiny Home" front sidewalk to match the size of the Small Path so it lines up

- Adjusted some invalid-area grids in the River town to provide more clear feedback

- Fixed an issue where the Level Up screen would auto-dismiss itself in certain circumstances

- Fixed an issue with the train timer not syncing up to the 6-hour clock properly

- Fixed an issue with Perk Point calculations

- Fixed an issue where you could press the DELETE or BACKSPACE key while holding an unowned item causing the Sell Item confirmation view to pop up when it shouldn't have.


* A note on the new "Micro-Snap" option: Use this mode with caution, especially with larger items. Typically, regular-type items will fit nicely within the established 'grid'. The Micro-Snap option should be used for smaller details like benches, tables and lining up your paths.


If you have any issues with the game either related to these updates or not, please post to the Bug Reports thread on the Discussion Board.

notes.title: Changelog for update v1.0.1
notes.notes:
- Added a "What's New?" panel on the main menu so that you know what to look for in new versions!

- Fixed an issue with resetting Perks. Upon reset using the RESET PERKS button in the Perks view, some players were not given back all of their earned Perk Points. This has been fixed

- Changed how the speed setting would reset to default after the Train Arrival. Now the speed settings stay on what you set it to when the Train Arrives and Departs.

- Dropped the requirement for the achievement "Traaaaaain!" to 250 Train Arrivals (previously was 1,000 arrivals)

- Changed the size of the "Simple Tree" collider so that it can be placed with more detail. This may also cause clipping into taller structures, so place appropriately!

- The Neighbors List will now disappear when "meeting" a Neighbor and resurface when closing the view

- Hid the grid from view while meeting Neighbors

- Added a grid-view Tip - "Press "G" to toggle the grid overlay" that pops up the first time you try to place an Object
